marketplace.summary: Takes untargeted LC-MS metabolomics from raw mzML to biological interpretation: xcms 4.x feature extraction, QC-based drift correction and normalization (pmp), confidence-stratified metabolite annotation (matchms/MetFrag) with MSI/Schymanski levels, permutation-validated statistics (PCA/OPLS-DA/univariate), and background-aware pathway mapping (MetaboAnalystR/FELLA). Batch/plate design and an alternate MS-DIAL/lipidomics route are included as supporting Skills. Research use only.

skills.name: bio-metabolomics-xcms-preprocessing
skills.description: Raw mzML to a feature table via CentWave peak detection, retention-time alignment, peak-density correspondence, gap-filling, CAMERA redundancy collapse, and QC feature filtering, with the peak-picking method matched to instrument resolution.

skills.name: bio-metabolomics-normalization-qc
skills.display_name: Metabolomics QC, Drift Correction and Normalization
skills.description: QC design, QC-RSC signal-drift correction, batch-effect removal, feature filtering, sample normalization (PQN) and mechanism-aware missing-value imputation for untargeted LC-MS/GC-MS, treating every step as a measurement model.

skills.name: bio-metabolomics-metabolite-annotation
skills.display_name: Metabolite Annotation and MSI Confidence Levels
skills.description: Turns LC-MS/MS features into confidence-stratified metabolite annotations via spectral-library matching (matchms), in-silico fragmentation (MetFrag; SIRIUS documented but login-gated), and molecular networking, assigning a defensible MSI/Schymanski level rather than a bare name.

skills.name: bio-metabolomics-statistical-analysis
skills.description: Decision-grade statistics for metabolomics intensity tables: transformation/scaling, PCA/HCA QC with Hotelling T2 outlier detection, permutation-validated PLS-DA/OPLS-DA, univariate testing (Welch/Mann-Whitney/ANOVA/LMM) with covariate adjustment, and dependence-aware multiple testing.

skills.name: bio-metabolomics-pathway-mapping
skills.description: Maps metabolomics results to biological pathways via over-representation analysis, metabolite-set enrichment (MSEA/QEA), mummichog/PSEA on raw m/z peaks, and FELLA network-diffusion enrichment, with correct background-set construction and honest interpretive ceilings.

skills.name: bio-metabolomics-msdial-preprocessing
skills.description: Runs the MS-DIAL console workflow (peak picking, MS2Dec deconvolution, alignment, gap-filling) for DIA/SWATH or GC-MS raw data and imports the alignment-result table into R or Python with an honest Fill%/MS-support filter, as an alternate entry point to xcms.

skills.name: bio-metabolomics-lipidomics
skills.description: Assigns honest lipid annotation levels (pygoslin/Goslin), designs class-based internal-standard quantification with a coverage guard, and runs lipid-aware differential and enrichment analysis with lipidr, guarding against in-source-fragment phantoms and sn-position over-claims.

skills.name: bio-workflows-metabolomics-pipeline
skills.description: Orchestrates the untargeted LC-MS metabolomics pipeline end-to-end across the five core Skills above, naming what each hand-off decides, enforcing the MSI-confidence gate and ionization-mode lock in real code, and naming where each stage can silently fail.

skills.name: bio-experimental-design-batch-design
skills.description: Balances batch, plate, run-order and (for TMT-style bridge designs) plex nuisance variation against the biological variable before any sample is run, so it stays estimable rather than confounded; includes SVA-based hidden-batch detection and a decision table for downstream correction.
